summary.text: Tom Stanley, listed by Ballotpedia as Thomas Stanley, is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 9th Middlesex District since 2001 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He also serves as an at-large member of the Waltham City Council and chairs the Joint Committee on Aging and Independence.

paragraphs.text: Stanley's education, as listed by Ballotpedia, includes an associate degree from Massachusetts Bay Community College, a bachelor's degree from Bentley College, and a graduate degree from the Suffolk University School of Management.
Stanley assumed office in the Massachusetts House in 2001 and is also an at-large member of the Waltham City Council, a seat he has held since 2018.
For the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Joint Committee on Aging and Independence.

Ballotpedia lists him as a member of the American Society for Public Administrators, Friends of Waltham Library, Hardy Pond Association, Massachusetts Government Finance Officers Association, and the Massachusetts Municipal Association Fiscal Policy Committee.
